summary: open_hosttest.c, the cleanup, errors and locking of an open and the calls by path, with faults in private copies of rach2/sys/syscall_fs.c, block/loop.c and mm/filemap.c

argv:
set -eu
t=${WORK}/tree
sh tests/proofs/tree.sh "$t" ${SRC} rach2/sys rach2/kernel.h rach2/vendor/multiboot.h tests/host
cd "$t"
s=rach2/sys
exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-unused-function -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I $s -I $s/arch/x86 -I $s/arch/i686 -I $s/lib -I $s/proc tests/host/open_hosttest.c $s/fs/fd.c $s/lib/kstring.c $s/lib/kctypes.c tests/host/compat/park_host.c -o ${WORK}/open_hosttest
